name: Proxy_A_composite_only
description: Keep shared_support_intensity_proxy only; drop all four component proxy variables.

name: Proxy_B_composite_plus_lactate
description: Keep shared proxy plus lactate component for perfusion interpretability.

name: Proxy_C_composite_plus_hemodynamic_lactate
description: Keep shared proxy plus hemodynamic and lactate components as the most clinically direct support subset.

name: Proxy_D_original_P15_all_components
description: Original P15 support proxy design: shared proxy plus all four components.

name: Shared support-intensity composite
description: Transportable support-intensity composite; proxy only, not full VIS.
interpretation: positive death-class coefficient in frozen P15; higher proxy burden is associated with higher death-risk logit

name: Hemodynamic support component
description: Circulatory support component; useful for P15 interpretability but removable in simpler subsets.
interpretation: positive death-class coefficient in frozen P15; higher proxy burden is associated with higher death-risk logit

name: Lactate/perfusion component
description: Perfusion component; retained in P12 as the most clinically direct support subcomponent.
interpretation: positive death-class coefficient in frozen P15; higher proxy burden is associated with higher death-risk logit

name: Renal support component
description: Renal support/decline component; useful in P15, excluded from simpler subsets.
interpretation: positive death-class coefficient in frozen P15; higher proxy burden is associated with higher death-risk logit

name: Respiratory support component
description: Respiratory support escalation component; useful in P15, excluded from simpler subsets.
interpretation: positive death-class coefficient in frozen P15; higher proxy burden is associated with higher death-risk logit
